[Act: limitation
 Chapter: Second Division · Appeals
 Section: 116::
]


Under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908)—
(a)to a High Court from any decree or order.
Period of limitationNinety days.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the decree or order.
(b)to any other court from any decree or order.
Period of limitationThirty days.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the decree or order.
